headline: Apple Launches Core AI for On-Device Generative AI, While Top Talent Leaves DeepMind
tldr: Today in AI, Apple unveiled Core AI, a framework for running large language models and generative AI on Apple devices. Meanwhile, Nobel laureate John Jumper is leaving DeepMind for Anthropic, signaling a shift in the AI talent landscape. Other notable developments include advancements in document intelligence and usage tracking at scale. These stories highlight the rapid evolution of AI capabilities and the ongoing competition for top talent in the field.

new_models.title: Apple Launches Core AI for Apple-Silicon Optimized On-Device Generative AI
new_models.summary: Apple announced the Core AI framework, allowing developers to run large language models and generative AI entirely on-device, supporting custom-converted PyTorch models and pre-optimized open-source models.
new_models.why_it_matters: This launch matters because it enables developers to create more powerful and private AI experiences on Apple devices, potentially expanding the reach of generative AI applications.

research.title: Making a PDF’s Images Searchable for RAG, Without Paying to Read Them All
research.summary: This article discusses a method for making PDF images searchable without having to read them all, using a tool called image_df to locate pictures and turning relevant ones into searchable text.
research.why_it_matters: This research matters because it addresses a common challenge in document intelligence, providing a cost-effective solution for searching and extracting information from PDF images.

features_updates.title: Inside Atlassian’s Forge Billing Architecture for Distributed Usage Tracking at Scale
features_updates.summary: Atlassian detailed its Forge billing platform, which processes large-scale usage events with correct attribution, deduplication, and aggregation using a streaming pipeline, idempotent processing, and layered storage.
features_updates.why_it_matters: This update matters because it showcases Atlassian's approach to usage-based pricing and billing, demonstrating how companies can effectively track and manage usage at scale.

industry_business.title: Nobel laureate John Jumper is leaving DeepMind for rival Anthropic
industry_business.summary: Nobel laureate John Jumper is leaving Google DeepMind for rival Anthropic, marking a significant shift in the AI talent landscape.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This move matters because it highlights the intense competition for top AI talent and the potential implications for the development of AI technologies at DeepMind and Anthropic.
